headlines.claim: Every client's composite has lower perplexity than the base on its own never-trained-on code.
Supports D3, not conclusive: in round 2, α = 0 removes a layer the client was trained on.
Within unmeasured seed noise: one seed, no interval.
SVD aggregation is ~2× closer to the exact average than naive factor averaging.
The SVD aggregate also completes held-out code better (within noise at 60 examples).
Base model on the 20-task HumanEval guard subset.

headlines.value: 13.9 pts now, 4.8 pts on full HumanEval
headlines.claim: D5's 2-point tolerance is below the guard's noise floor.
